About Us

  • Introduction
  • Vision & Mission
  • Our Solutions

DEXTRANS LOGISTICS (I) PVT LTD incorporated in 2010 is renowned for its global logistics management services with head office in Mumbai, branches/associates all over India and strong partners worldwide. We are licensed Custom House Agent, IATA, MTO, Breakbulk & FFFAI Networks as well.

We diligently operate at the highest standards achievable so that we can give our customers the best service experience possible. With our customer-friendly and efficient services, we have earned a commendatory reputation of trust and goodwill among our clients. Hence, we are acknowledged as a leader in the logistics market.

Vision

To promote Teamwork and create a work Environment encouraging the workforce to Continuously strive for Innovative, Quality & Focus on High – quality services towards customer under one roof and capture the essence of who we are and how much we care for our customers

  • Sales Drive
  • Customer Focused
  • Growth Oriented
  • Leading
  • Integrated Service Provider.

Mission

Our Mission is to provide a world class quality service regardless of the size of a company, scope of work or mode of transport and building Customer loyalty every year.

“We are architects in logistics and transport. We plan and construct a network to transport goods easily and reliably by Sea, Air & land. We know regional conditions and give individual support to our customers to be globally successful”.

We at Dextrans are equipped to help our clients with any kind of transportation that requires logistics services, all under a single roof.
